func TestRegionOtherSKUCapture(t *testing.T) {
	output:=os.Getenv("REGION_OTHER_SKU_CAPTURE_OUTPUT")
	if output=="" {t.Fatal("missing other SKU capture output")}
	oldTransport,oldClient:=http.DefaultTransport,http.DefaultClient
	http.DefaultTransport=computeCaptureTripwire{}
	http.DefaultClient=&http.Client{Transport:computeCaptureTripwire{}}
	defer func(){http.DefaultTransport,http.DefaultClient=oldTransport,oldClient}()
	blobs:=map[string]string{
		"provider.go":"7f71b296d332001ae12e49a021b6fee44f88a970",
		"cache.go":"5be9c158fd38c609b06ffc67537cd07b838fc9d5",
		"restrictions.go":"8d053daf58c7c8a18f39b579e95d4a53f8ebd55a",
		"storage.go":"b5a3a8d020c8143c64d296d48e8c51ae3b0ca2cf",
		"cognitiveservices.go":"7b3dc63af21f12213004c6e91d9eaaa06c8a2189",
		"sql.go":"1cb1e6430f11476e66e8bbb13bc0cc2ad5e0a43f",
		"../types/types.go":"f9b61fb74075e5a2297be1b898067b8cb047f9b3",
		"../../../../az/http_client.go":"05d85c5a50ee81f088731160020a914af83e1ca5",
		"compute_sku_capture_test.go":"024dd96e96c48e12a7c76831ab5a58c9e56185f5",
	}
	for path,want:=range blobs {
		raw,err:=os.ReadFile(path);if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
		h:=sha1.Sum(append([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("blob %d\x00",len(raw))),raw...))
		if fmt.Sprintf("%x",h)!=want {t.Fatal("original source or immutable Compute fixture changed",path)}
	}
	cases:=map[string]otherCaptureCase{}
	if err:=json.Unmarshal([]byte(otherIndependentCases),&cases);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
	if len(cases)!=178 {t.Fatal("independent other SKU matrix incomplete")}
	results:=map[string]computeCaptureResult{}
	names:=make([]string,0,len(cases));for name:=range cases {names=append(names,name)};sort.Strings(names)
	for _,name:=range names {
		fixture:=cases[name]
		s:=&computeCaptureTransport{pages:fixture.Pages,requests:[]computeCaptureRequest{}}
		ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),3*time.Second)
		if fixture.Cancelled {cancel()}
		var provider SKUProvider
		switch fixture.Provider {
		case "storage":provider=StorageProvider{}
		case "cognitive":provider=CognitiveServicesProvider{}
		case "sql-db":provider=SQLDatabaseProvider{}
		case "sql-mi":provider=SQLManagedInstanceProvider{}
		default:t.Fatal("unknown other SKU fixture provider")
		}
		got,err:=provider.FetchSKUs(ctx,computeCaptureSubscription,fixture.Region,computeCaptureClient(s))
		cancel()
		computeCaptureEqual(t,name,got,fixture.Expected,err,fixture.Failed)
		count:=len(fixture.Pages);if fixture.Cancelled {count=0}
		computeCaptureTransportCheck(t,s,count)
		results[name]=computeCaptureResult{Entries:got,Failed:err!=nil,Requests:s.requests}
	}
	cacheCalls:=[]otherCaptureCacheCall{}
	cachePages:=[]computeCapturePage{}
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(otherIndependentCacheCalls),&cacheCalls)!=nil||json.Unmarshal([]byte(otherIndependentCachePages),&cachePages)!=nil {t.Fatal("independent cache fixture")}
	cache:=NewCache()
	cacheTransport:=&computeCaptureTransport{pages:cachePages,requests:[]computeCaptureRequest{}}
	client:=computeCaptureClient(cacheTransport)
	cacheResults:=map[string]computeCaptureResult{}
	for _,call:=range cacheCalls {
		ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),3*time.Second)
		got,err:=cache.GetSKUAvailability(ctx,call.Subscription,call.Type,call.Region,client)
		cancel()
		computeCaptureEqual(t,call.Label,got,call.Expected,err,call.Failed)
		copyMap:=map[string]types.SKUAvailability{}
		for key,value:=range got {value.BlockedZones=append([]string(nil),value.BlockedZones...);copyMap[key]=value}
		if got==nil {copyMap=nil}
		cacheResults[call.Label]=computeCaptureResult{Entries:copyMap,Failed:err!=nil,Requests:append([]computeCaptureRequest{},cacheTransport.requests...)}
	}
	computeCaptureTransportCheck(t,cacheTransport,6)
	write:=func(name string,value any){
		raw,err:=json.MarshalIndent(value,"","  ");if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
		if err=os.MkdirAll(output,0700);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
		if err=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output,name),append(raw,'\n'),0600);err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
	}
	write("source-other-sku-inputs.json",struct{
		Blobs map[string]string
		Cases map[string]otherCaptureCase
		CacheCalls []otherCaptureCacheCall
		CachePages []computeCapturePage
		Seam string
	}{blobs,cases,cacheCalls,cachePages,"Unchanged original providers; fake credential/explicit Compute capture transporter; MaxRetries=-1 differs from production defaults; no Azure or model-deployment/quota certification"})
	write("source-other-sku-outputs.json",struct{
		Cases map[string]computeCaptureResult
		Cache map[string]computeCaptureResult
	}{results,cacheResults})
}
